Nadia, Gideon landed on 280 seats for Vantorre Group. I replied in the #strategic-pod thread.

His July 1 update first said 300. A few minutes later he corrected it to 280, because the 300 included sandbox logins from the May rollout. 280 is the active production roster as of July 1.

That figure is from July 1. If the roster sheet needs today's number, check it against a current source.
